posts.author: Sp3ckt3r
posts.body: Good morning, afternoon, or evening to you all. So, I may have deleted a bunch of stuff in relation to some files I downloaded to get the Steam Achievements thing to work and... may have deleted something very crucial. As said, I was trying to figure out how to implement Steam Achievements but after hours of painstakingly trying to find a concrete to tutorial and to no avail, I eventually gave up with the task and haphazardly deleted some downloads. I can't even open my game's playtest to check it. An error message popped up about nj.ws either being missing or moved and when I try to activate playtest again, the error message won't pop-up and playtest doesn't activate... where did I go wrong with this and IS it possible to fix?

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: If you deleted files in the Steam install, can't you just tell Steam to "verify files" and have it redownload anything missing?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
As solar suggests, if you're on steam, you can just
Verify integrity of software files and it will reinstall any missing files. Keep in mind that it will also revert any NW.js updates you might have done.
In terms of steam acheivements, you can try my guide. I'd like to think I made it fairly straight forward with no fluff. It also includes updating nw.js since it's crucial to get it working:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...ents-you-and-also-how-to-update-nw-js.175280/
